items.title_en: 'I Don't Get Paid Overtime': Employee Says Boss Keeps Dumping ‘Quick’ Tasks 10 Minutes Before Shift Ends
items.title_zh: “我没有加班费”：员工称老板在轮班结束前 10 分钟不断放弃“快速”任务
items.summary_en: An employee on Reddit seeks advice after their boss repeatedly assigns last-minute tasks before clock-out, forcing them to choose between unpaid overtime and unfinished work
items.summary_zh: 一名员工在 Reddit 上寻求建议，因为老板反复在下班前分配最后一刻的任务，迫使他们在无薪加班和未完成的工作之间做出选择

items.title_en: Passengers sing ‘Jaane se Guzarte Hain’ on train, netizens say, ‘Mehfil-e-Railways’
items.title_zh: 乘客在火车上唱“Jaane se Guzarte Hain”，网友称“Mehfil-e-Railways”
items.summary_en: Commuters turned a regular journey into a heartwarming musical session by breaking into a soulful rendition of Jaane Se Guzarte Hain.
items.summary_zh: 乘客们随着 Jaane Se Guzarte Hain 深情的演绎，将普通的旅程变成了一场温馨的音乐盛宴。
